outcome: Serum levels of interleukin-2 (IL-2), IL-4, IL-6, IL-10, tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), and interferon-γ (IFN-γ)
cohort: 358 hospitalized children under 1 year old with lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI), including 116 with RSV infection and 242 without RSV or other specific pathogens
finding: Serum IL-6 levels were significantly elevated in RSV-infected infants with low birth weight, suggesting a potential role of IL-6 in the pathogenesis of RSV infection in this vulnerable population.
mod_finding: Delivery mode did not significantly influence changes in serum cytokine levels among RSV-infected infants with or without wheezing.
birth_weight: Infants with low birth weight and normal birth weight were included in the study.
